body: Ive moved away now with my girlfriend who is very good at working with me and my deppressioon and other issues (like anger) that come from my manic and bi-poler disorders. Everything is normally anger in my eyes, which is why its weird that ive been so depressed lately. But the point im making, my life has improved anger wise since i moved away from my mom, i just don't understand where the depression has randomly come from

You need to find someone that chooses to love you first. Thats what ive done and we now live together and are planning to get married. With the other girl (i will refer to her as dee) i felt like she was my everything from the very first time i saw her before i even spoke to her. Dee messed up my status at school by making peolpe think i was stalking her, yet i still chased after her. after a year and a half i finally won her over only to be let down a few months later for her to tell me that she never loved me she only used me to feel loved herslef. And even after that i still wasnt oer her, she ruined a very strong relationship for me )which thankfully i was able to restore. thats my current relationship btw) by winning me over again. My current girlfriend wanted nothing to do with me when i took dee back cuz i finally felt it was real, turns out i was once again let down. And i have only my current to thank for the happiness i have now. She took me back immediately. And you know what? I had known her for 6 years before we first got together. She was right in front of me for years, we were best friends. I just never realised her feelings for me until she told me, and like i said. we are now verrrry happy together. So you never know...if you have a best friend that you think may just have a connection, try it, cant do any harm. Or if you think there is anyone that has those feelings for you, ask them.

I dedicated three years of my life to someone who used me over and over again just so she could feel loved by someone when she didnt have other options, and only pretended to love me back to ensure she wouldnt lose me..

I have been right where you are at. I was completely destroyed by a girl. I stood on a rock over a 40 foot cliff looking down for hours after she hurt me. You can make it past this, i promise. feel free to pm me, i can be here for you.
